name: The Making of Raygen
thesis: Tell Raygen’s story as a bold, ink-framed comic made entirely from his real avatar, community artwork, and machines.
interaction: A single page-reveal entrance leads through staggered story panels; the SERV0 panel lets readers remove and replace its actual enclosure panels.
why: Hack Club and Stardance take the opening spotlight, while printers enter as the story’s next reveal, with expressive comic lettering and original artwork carrying the personality.
